notes.title: M1: A Death in the Desert launches on Steam
notes.notes: It's here. M1: A Death in the Desert, a visual novel by Dracula's Cave is now available on Steam. Embark on a violence-soaked post-apocalyptic adventure where the answers to your questions come at a price. How far will you go to discover the truth?
